[2026-08-01] announcement | Welcome to SUN Reborn
SUN Reborn is a progressive Soul of the Ultimate Nation server. You start at level one, the cap is sixty, and the rates are the ones the game was designed around.

The cash shop is priced at zero across the board and every account carries the premium flag. There is nothing to buy, so there is nothing to lose by playing for free -- because free is the only tier there is.
